Springfield Properties plc
15 September 2026
Final Results and Publication of Annual Report
Springfield Properties (AIM: SPR) announces results for the year ended 31 May 2026.
Revenue £243.7m; adjusted PBT £12.9m. Net bank cash £1.2m at year end, versus £20.9m net bank debt.
Proposed dividend 3.0p versus 2.0p. Subject to shareholder approval.
Private housing revenue £165.0m; affordable housing revenue £54.3m.
Land sales £14.1m versus £60.5m. Final deferred consideration of £20.7m paid after year end.
The company intends to commence a share buyback programme.

note.impact_rationale: Significance of the disclosed change, not a predicted share-price reaction.
note.headline: Housing revenue grows; net bank debt cleared
note.takeaway: Private and affordable housing revenue grew. Lower land sales reduced reported revenue and profit, while the dividend proposal rose to 3.0p.

what_changed.today: Net bank debt of £20.9m became £1.2m net bank cash at year-end. The proposed dividend rose 50%; a share buyback is planned.
what_changed.read_through: A stronger balance sheet gives Springfield more flexibility. The £1.2m cash figure is at 31 May, before the £20.7m acquisition payment made after year-end.

note.analyst_view: A stronger balance sheet gives Springfield more flexibility. The £1.2m cash figure is at 31 May, before the £20.7m acquisition payment made after year-end.
challenges_case: The buyback is intended, not described as having started.
